from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action (案由) as stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
